summary: Stronger protection for scripts, updates and sign-ins across PIM Manager.

fixes.title: Published scripts need PowerShell 7
fixes.text: Every script published for you now needs PowerShell 7 and lists the role you need and the addresses it reaches.

fixes.title: Checked hybrid worker installs
fixes.text: Security improvements for hybrid worker installs.

fixes.title: Local PIM Manager opens with a one-time link
fixes.text: The local PIM Manager opens with a one-time link.

fixes.title: Access-request keys can be limited
fixes.text: Access-request keys and applications can now be limited to named groups.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Stronger sign-in checks, the hub owner script runs on its own again, and more AI assistant tools are listed.
